definitions.short: Perets , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H6557. Perets II. פֶ֫רֶץ proper name 1. person, masculine son of Judah and Tamar , φαρες ; — ׳פ Gen 46:12 +, מָּ֑רֶץ 38:29 3 t.; — 38:29 ; 46:12 (twice in verse); Num 26:20-21 , Ruth 4:12 , 18 (twice in verse); 1Chr 2:4-5 , 4:1 ; 9:4 ; 27:9 ; Neh 11:4 , 6 2. location in a. ׳פ עֻזָּה near Jerusalem 2Sam 6:8 2Chr 13:11 . b. מְּרָצִים הַר Isa 28:21 , perhaps = פ ׳בַּעַל q. v. p. Isaiah 12:8. — compare מָּ֑רֶץ רִמֹּן . p.942.
